summary_1line: Bharata tells Rama that their father Dasaratha died of grief after Rama’s exile and urges Rama to return to Ayodhya and take the throne.

image_candidates.scene_text: Bharata stands before Rama in the forest, sorrowfully announcing that King Dasaratha died grieving for his exiled son.
Rama, Sita, and Lakshmana listen in shock as Bharata recounts their father’s death beneath the forest trees.
